scripts.zip: python -c "import os, zipfile; z = zipfile.ZipFile('deploy.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(os.path.join(r, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, f), 'dist').replace('\\', '/')) for r, d, fs in os.walk('dist') for f in fs]; z.close()"
scripts.deploy-bundle: npm run build && npm run zip
